# [E7 — Pesticides and degradation products](../openproblems/E7.md "Pesticides and degradation products")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/openproblem_e7.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-STATUS">**Missing: measurement.** The quantity the hypothesis is about is held only thinly: the held marine water chemistry names a herbicide and two degradation products of herbicides, on [62](../SOURCES.md#F-1d69e55cf8) to [63](../SOURCES.md#F-8a5714e136) records each, and nothing held pairs them with a fauna response. [E7](../openproblems/E7.md "Pesticides and degradation products") is **unscoreable here, not refuted**.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What a test would need, and which side is empty

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-NEEDS">[E7](../openproblems/E7.md "Pesticides and degradation products") says agricultural pesticides reach the sea and act on non-target organisms, and that they are collinear with nitrogen because the same farming produces both. Discriminating it needs, at shared positions: (a) a concentration of at least one **named** active substance or degradation product in water, sediment or biota; (b) a fauna or algal response; (c) a nutrient-load covariate to hold fixed.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-NEEDS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-SIDES">(a) is held, thinly, in the water chemistry. (b) is in ODA `Bundfauna`, not fetched. (c) is not held as a load: the water carries nutrient concentrations, but river load lives on an ODA endpoint `fetch_oda.py` cannot reach.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-SIDES "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What is actually here - counted

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-PANEL">`docs/data/areas/stations_series.json` - [679,422](../SOURCES.md#F-b61d7944ec) station-months, [1,415](../SOURCES.md#F-fff0060a3d) stations, [564](../SOURCES.md#F-008df4b99b) monthly slots from [1980](../SOURCES.md#F-44433af5f2), across [9](../SOURCES.md#F-81bea72caf) variables: fluorescence, oxygen and oxygen saturation (bed and surface), salinity and temperature (bed and surface). **No toxicant variable of any kind.** Near-bed oxygen alone is [76,980](../SOURCES.md#F-a95c664ddf) station-months over [1,327](../SOURCES.md#F-a053d110be) stations: the response-side record is dense; the exposure side has no column to sit in there.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-PANEL "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-REG">`data/raw/oda/stations.csv` - the ODA station register: [798,574](../SOURCES.md#F-bd74e20689) rows, [6,288](../SOURCES.md#F-1acb8bcb68) distinct stations.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-REG "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-CTD">`data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` - [53,710,760](../SOURCES.md#F-4df017f985) records; the `Parameter` column takes [17](../SOURCES.md#F-779d628231) distinct values: Temperatur, Salinitet, Oxygen indhold, Fluorescens, Oxygenmætning, Lysdæmpning, Konduktivitet, Vægtfylde, Turbiditet, FDOM, Photometer måling, Photometer reference, pH, Strømhastighed, Strømretning, Farvestof, Dihydrogensulfid. **Not one is a pesticide, a degradation product, or any organic contaminant.**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-CTD "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-KEMI">`data/raw/oda/kemi.csv.gz`, the marine water chemistry with its hazardous substances, is held, and among its `Parameter` values are `Diuron` on [63](../SOURCES.md#F-8a5714e136) records, a herbicide, and `Hydroxy-atrazin` on [62](../SOURCES.md#F-1d69e55cf8) and `Hydroxysimazin` on [63](../SOURCES.md#F-bd2aa15b15), the hydroxy forms of the triazine herbicides atrazine and simazine; beside them two chlorinated phenoxypropionic acids, `2-(2,6-dichlorphenoxy)propionsyre` on [100](../SOURCES.md#F-b4aaddf0af) and `2-(2-Chlor-6-methylphenoxy)propionsyre` on [984](../SOURCES.md#F-a19f846432), whose use this page has not checked.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-KEMI "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-KEMI-THIN">The held counts are records per parameter; how many stations and years they span has not been counted, so whether they meet the test below is open.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-KEMI-THIN "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The national pollutant-status layer

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-MFS">`data/raw/national/sw_mfs_tilstand.geojson` - **[256](../SOURCES.md#F-2e0664e8b7) points, none of them marine**: [152](../SOURCES.md#F-b66947c89f) `DKLAKE`, [104](../SOURCES.md#F-886deb6674) `DKRIVER`. Matrices flagged: biota [253](../SOURCES.md#F-4d1a1b05ed), water [174](../SOURCES.md#F-08fa672da8), **sediment [5](../SOURCES.md#F-fad92131f2)**, nothing [3](../SOURCES.md#F-37d1c997e7).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-MFS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-MFS-ONE">What each point carries is `qecode = "QE3-3 - River Basin Specific Pollutants"`, `qestatusor = "3"`, `da_oekolog = "2"` and `aktivstart = 01-01-1999`, each the same on all [256](../SOURCES.md#F-2e0664e8b7). **No analyte name, no concentration, no unit, no sampling date.**</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-MFS-ONE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-CONFLATE">**Schema conflation.** One quality-element code stands for every river-basin-specific pollutant, whatever the substance, in a single column. A pesticide effect cannot be separated from any other pollutant's even in principle at this resolution.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-CONFLATE "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-VERDICT">**Model-as-datum.** The value is a status verdict, and it is invariant across all [256](../SOURCES.md#F-2e0664e8b7) points, so it carries no information for discriminating anything.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-VERDICT "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-NOMARINE">No marine water body here carries a hazardous-substance observation: of the [123](../SOURCES.md#F-9b5234765d) marine water bodies, [0](../SOURCES.md#F-b2b6fccc0e) have a point of the layer, because every point belongs to a lake or a river.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-NOMARINE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Why *measurement* and not the other two

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-NOTEXP">Not **experiment**: no intervention is required. Ordinary monitoring, of a kind already run for nutrients, would produce the series.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-NOTEXP "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-ARMCHAIR">Not yet **armchair**: an armchair block means the numbers exist and joining them is merely too large.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-ARMCHAIR "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-MFSTOPICS">The source register records the analyte lists of the ODA marine hazardous-substance topics: sediment (`ODA-SEDKEMI-MFS`) phthalates, alkylphenols and bulk carbon, and no pesticide; mussels (`ODA-MFS-MUSLING`) organotins, metals, PAH, dioxins and PCBs; fish (`ODA-MFS-FISK`) PFAS, brominated flame retardants, PCBs, dioxins, HCH, DDT and DDE, HCB and mercury.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-MFSTOPICS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-LEGACY">So pesticides do appear in the marine record - HCH, whose gamma isomer lindane has been used as an agricultural insecticide, in fish, and the herbicides above in the water - but whether any is dense enough to join against fauna is the test below, not yet run.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-LEGACY "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-RECLASS">**Reclassification test, stated in advance.** If named pesticide or degradation-product analytes are found at ≥[20](../SOURCES.md#F-1a68f99696) marine stations with ≥[5](../SOURCES.md#F-214c717648) years of dated results and a non-censored fraction above [33](../SOURCES.md#F-b66ba59fb8)%, [E7](../openproblems/E7.md "Pesticides and degradation products") moves to **armchair** and this page is wrong. Anything thinner leaves it here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-RECLASS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Smallest unblocking thing

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-S1">**Count, then enumerate.** In the held water chemistry, count stations and years for each pesticide parameter - that decides the test above for the water. Then run the topic and parameter *metadata* calls `scripts/fetch_oda.py` already implements (`expand`, `option_list`) against Hav / Sedimentkemi / MFS Sporstof and Hav / MFS i biota, and record the parameter names and per-parameter station counts. Metadata only, no extract.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-S1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-S2">**If that is too thin**, the smallest useful addition is one analyte panel bolted onto stations that already carry fauna: [20](../SOURCES.md#F-0e36027845) existing `Bundfauna` stations spanning an agricultural gradient, sampled before application, twice after, and in winter, sediment plus passive samplers. The requirements, each of which the national pollutant-status layer violates: **named analytes reported individually, never a "pesticides" sum**; **per-analyte LOD reported with every result**, chosen below the effect concentration for the conserved target rather than wherever the instrument lands; and **"< LOD" recorded as censoring with its threshold**, so a non-detect is reportable as a bound instead of silently becoming a zero.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-S2 "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-PANELCHOICE">Pick the panel by target conservation, not market label: a photosystem-II inhibitor with its degradation product, since the algae the chlorophyll indicator counts photosynthesise, and glyphosate with AMPA, its breakdown product in soil.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-PANELCHOICE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What such data would, and would not, license

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-LICENSE">Even a complete marine pesticide series would **not** license "pesticides did it". [E7](../openproblems/E7.md "Pesticides and degradation products")'s own prediction is that pesticide and nitrogen load are collinear because one agriculture produces both, so a concentration series is only discriminating where the two vary independently - same nutrient load, different pesticide exposure. Whether that contrast exists anywhere in Danish waters is a second, unanswered measurement question, and it is worth answering *before* collecting the first series rather than after.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-LICENSE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-OQ-E7-LICENSE2">What the series would license immediately is narrower and still worth having: a statement of whether the exposure is present at concentrations near the effect thresholds of the conserved targets at all - which this project has not examined, for the held herbicide records or any other.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-OQ-E7-LICENSE2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
